biotools.summary: ArtSymbioCyc is a metabolism-oriented database collection for arthropods and their associated bacteria, utilizing BioCyc tools for high-quality annotations and metabolic network analysis. It facilitates the study of symbiotic relationships, such as the tripartite symbiosis of the cereal aphid *Sipha maydis*, revealing interdependent metabolic pathways.
